# Koraltech Softwares

> Koraltech Softwares is a custom software development company based in Bengaluru, India. Koraltech Softwares provides requirement analysis, structured requirement engineering, full-stack web and mobile application development, project management, deployment, support, and ongoing maintenance with AI integration at every stage.

## Company Overview

- **Legal Name:** Koraltech Softwares
- **Website:** https://www.koraltech.in
- **Email:** info@koraltech.in
- **Phone:** +91 9597876354
- **Headquarters:** Bengaluru, Karnataka, India
- **Global Markets:** USA, London, United Arab Emirates, India, Australia

## Core Offerings

- [Web App Development](https://www.koraltech.in/services#web-app-development): Full-stack web application engineering using React, Node.js, and modern TypeScript architecture.
- [Mobile App Development](https://www.koraltech.in/services#mobile-app-development): Cross-platform mobile applications using React Native and hybrid native technologies.
- [AI Integrated Development](https://www.koraltech.in/services#ai-integrated-development): Intelligent automation, document parsing, speech-to-text, NLP, and custom machine learning integration.
- [Cloud Infrastructure Services](https://www.koraltech.in/services#cloud-infrastructure): Cloud migration, DevOps, automated CI/CD pipelines, and infrastructure management across Microsoft Azure, AWS, and Firebase.
- [API Development](https://www.koraltech.in/services#api-development): Scalable RESTful API design, system integration, and microservices.
- [BLE App Development](https://www.koraltech.in/services#ble-app-development): Bluetooth Low Energy IoT connectivity and low-power hardware-software integration.
- [Software Product Engineering](https://www.koraltech.in/services#software-product-engineering): MVP development, architecture design, and enterprise-grade software delivery.
- [IT Staff Augmentation](https://www.koraltech.in/services#it-staff-augmentation): Dedicated software engineers, mobile developers, and technical project managers.

## Technology Stack

- **Frontend:** React, Ionic React, TailwindCSS, TypeScript
- **Mobile:** React Native, iOS, Android
- **Backend:** Node.js, TypeScript, .NET / C#, REST APIs
- **Cloud & DevOps:** Microsoft Azure, AWS, Firebase, Azure Functions, CI/CD
- **Databases:** Sequelize, Firestore, PostgreSQL, MongoDB
- **AI / ML:** OpenAI Integration, Document AI, OCR, Speech-to-Text, NLP

## Delivery Process

1. **Discover & Analyze:** Business requirements and technical discovery workshops.
2. **Structure Requirements:** User stories, technical architecture, and milestones.
3. **Design & Develop:** Full-stack implementation with continuous testing.
4. **Manage & Deploy:** CI/CD pipeline automation and cloud deployment.
5. **Support & Maintain:** SLA-backed monitoring, bug fixes, and performance tuning.
